label: training-gym-r39-complete
context:
Training Gym R39 completed. All 4 exercises 10/10.

R39 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. interval-tree-001 (T8) - Interval Tree with point query and range query, max_end pruning. 6 tests. Clean.
2. btree-001 (T8) - B-Tree order=3 with insert/split, delete with merge/borrow. 6 tests. Clean.
3. uf-path-splitting-001 (T6) - Union-Find with path splitting (grandparent), compared to path compression. 5 tests. Bug: path splitting only halves chain, not logarithmic.
4. cuckoo-filter-001 (T8) - Cuckoo Filter with fingerprint, XOR alt-index, eviction. 5 tests. Clean.

KEY PATTERNS:
- Interval tree: BST by start, max_end field for pruning queries
- B-Tree delete: predecessor from left subtree or successor from right, merge when both below min
- Path splitting: parent[x] = parent[parent[x]] — iterative, halves path each find
- Cuckoo: fp=sha256(item)[0], h1=sha256(item), h2=h1 XOR sha256(fp), eviction loop

DB: 230 exercises, 395 attempts, avg 9.87
decisions: Path splitting is O(log n) amortized but single pass on chain only halves — not as good as recursive path compression for single calls
B-Tree delete: always ensure child has >= t keys before descending, merge/borrow as needed
Cuckoo filter: ensure fingerprint is non-zero (OR with 1) so XOR alt-index actually changes the bucket
next_steps: Design R40 exercises. Continue with: Fenwick Tree (BIT), Skip List, Consistent Hashing, or HyperLogLog.
